QuestInfo.name: The Demon's Lair 2
QuestInfo.0: The battle rages on. Now that the allied forces are inside the temple, talk to Takeda Shingen.
QuestInfo.1: Shingen wants you to find and defeat 300 Samurai Captains.
QuestInfo.2: The Oda troops are running around with no leadership! Victory is at hand!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 5,711,777\nCan proceed to the The Demon's Lair 3 quest

0.0: The real fight starts here. I'm sending in my best men to begin the assault, and I want you alongside them. Ready for some action?

yes.0: Fight your way deeper into the battlefield and take care of the samurai captains. I can't wait to watch them scrambling around without their bosses.
yes.1: Could you take care of 300 Oda Samurai Captains? It's the only way to win a battle.

no.0: What happened, did somebody cut off your power? I knew I couldn't trust those camp barbers...

yes.0: See that? The enemies are scattering! Their base is crumbling! I can feel the winds of victory ruffling my mustache. Today is the day I feel like a king!

default.0: Disrupt the enemy chain of command by defeating 300 Oda Samurai Captains.
